4) Foot : Ankle

Explanation: The relationship between "Hand" and "Wrist" is that the wrist is a joint or a connecting part of the hand, just as the ankle is a joint or a connecting part of the foot. Both pairs involve a body part and its associated joint.

Skull : Stomach - These are unrelated body parts with no direct connection similar to "Hand" and "Wrist."

Ear : Hair - These are unrelated body parts, so they don't share the same connection as "Hand" and "Wrist."

Thus, the pair that best represents a similar relationship is Foot : Ankle.

questions.q_en: At what time between 8 O'Clock and 9 O'Clock, will the minute hand and hour hand of the clock make right angles?
questions.solution_en:
To determine when the minute hand and hour hand of a clock will form right angles between 8:00 and 9:00, we can use the following approach:

Position of the hour hand: At 8:00, the hour hand is at 240 degrees (each hour represents 30 degrees, so 8 X 30=240). The hour hand moves at a rate of 0.5 degrees per minute (since it moves 30 degrees in 60 minutes).

Therefore, after m minutes past 8:00, the position of the hour hand will be:

Hour hand position= 240+0.5m

Position of the minute hand: The minute hand starts at 0 degrees at 8:00 and moves at a rate of 6 degrees per minute (since it moves 360 degrees in 60 minutes).

After m minutes past 8:00, the position of the minute hand will be:

Minute hand position=6m

Finding right angles: The minute hand and hour hand will be at right angles (90 degrees apart) if:

∣Minute hand position−Hour hand position∣=90

This gives us two cases to solve:

Case 1:

6m−(240+0.5m)=90

6m - 240 - 0.5m=90

5.5m=90+240

5.5m=330

m=60 minutes, which is not possible as it exceed 60 minutes.

So, case 1 gets cancelled.

Case 2:

6m - (240+0.5m)=-90

6m - 240 - 0.5m=-90

5.5m=-90+240

5.5m=150

m=27.27

8 hours 27.27 minutes

Seconds = 0.27 X 60 seconds = 16.2 16

Thus, the hands of the clock will make right angles at 8:27:16.

questions.q_en: Shweta starts walking from her office and walks 150 m towards the south, then she turns right and walks 80 m, and then she turns left and walks 60 m. She finally turns left and walks 280 m to reach a bank. What is the shortest distance between her office and the bank?
questions.solution_en:
• Shweta starts walking from her office and walks 150 m towards the south, then she turns right and walks 80 m, and then she turns left and walks 60 m.

• She finally turns left and walks 280 m to reach a bank.

The shortest distance between her bank and office = (200)² + (210)²

= 40000 + 44100

= 84100 = (290)²

The shortest distance between her bank and office = 290 m
